method: Six fresh workers per case/variant, 15 observations each, two warmups; all six variant execution permutations across samples. Each worker verifies the full 21-case oracle before timing.

trees_metadata.timing: Fresh UTF-8 source/stream, full recognition and domain value; excludes preparation, assertions, diagnostics formatting, result release and cycle collection
trees_metadata.memory: Same warmed worker; retained result and domain object; peaks include baseline process allocations. Peak reset is unavailable on PHP 8.1.

values_metadata.timing: Fresh UTF-8 source/stream, full recognition and domain value; excludes preparation, assertions, diagnostics formatting, result release and cycle collection
values_metadata.memory: Same warmed worker; retained result and domain object; peaks include baseline process allocations. Peak reset is unavailable on PHP 8.1.

worker_command_template: php tools/compare-binding.php --worker=comprehend or binding --case=CASE --size=128 --iterations=15 --warmups=2; add --without-trees for the values variant; execution order is recorded by balanced_measurements.
